ambiguities: Report does not establish that the taker is unauthorized or that anyone can call the order-processing function; no permission or caller constraint is stated.
Report does not confirm the 1/2 amounts scenario was observed on-chain; it is presented as an example ('In practice').
Report does not specify whether order book state is consistent before the call (e.g., prior partial fills or existing matched liquidity).
Report does not state whether the revert is the only outcome or whether retries with different amounts succeed.
Report's DoS claim ('attacker can systematically revert genuine matches') is asserted in the Impact section without a demonstrated repeatable attack transaction.
